content: For bulk insert from a JSONB array in Postgres, prefer set-based INSERT ... SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(...) with ON CONFLICT (unique_col) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, rather than a plpgsql loop with per-row EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation blocks (each caught exception in a loop implicitly creates a subtransaction/savepoint, which is a documented performance anti-pattern for large batches).
